Acreage and Farm Investments Decisions Amidst Uncertainty: A Case Study of Rural India
abstract: This study provides evidence‐based information on the impact of the pandemic lockdown and other COVID‐19‐related policies on Indian rural households' decisions on‐farm investments and operations (planting and borrowing decisions). The study uses the World Bank's (2021) high‐frequency rural household‐level survey across six states of India for the 2020 Kharif crop season. Our analyses also show that farm households exhibit differences in their perception of the pandemic's impact on their farming operations. In terms of input cost, farm households exhibited heterogeneous reactions to input costs like fertilizer during the early part of the pandemic. Our results also show that government incentives in the form of cash transfers do not significantly impact households' farm operations decisions (including loan acquisitions). [EconLit Citations: C36, D19, Q12, R20].
abstract_zh: 本研究提供了基于证据的信息，说明新冠疫情封锁及其他COVID-19相关政策对印度农村家庭农场投资和经营决策（种植和借贷决策）的影响。本研究使用世界银行（2021）针对印度六个邦的高频农村家庭调查数据，涵盖2020年卡里夫（Kharif）作物季。我们的分析还表明，农户对疫情对其农业经营影响的感知存在差异。就投入成本而言，在疫情初期，农户对化肥等投入成本的反应各不相同。我们的结果还表明，以现金转移支付形式提供的政府激励并未显著影响农户的农业经营决策（包括贷款获取）。[EconLit分类号：C36, D19, Q12, R20]。

title: Farm-Level Agricultural Productivity and Adaptation to Extreme Heat
Gender Dynamics and Aspirational Disparities in Agriculture
abstract: Despite increasing scholarly attention to individual aspirations, rural women's aspirations in agriculture remain largely unexplored. With women increasingly central to agricultural work, understanding their aspirations is crucial. Using farm surveys from Ecuador, Kenya, and Rwanda, we investigate the relationship between gender and aspiration formation in agriculture. Similar to previous findings related to education and entrepreneurship, our findings show women have lower ambitions for agricultural production. Addressing the unique challenges they face, gender‐sensitive policies are vital for inclusive, sustainable agriculture. Our study contributes to a broader understanding of the multidimensional factors shaping agricultural outcomes, underscoring the importance of integrating diverse perspectives for effective policy formulation in agriculture.
abstract_zh: 尽管学界对个人抱负的关注日益增加，农村妇女在农业中的抱负仍基本未被探讨。随着妇女在农业劳动中日益居于核心地位，理解她们的抱负至关重要。利用来自厄瓜多尔、肯尼亚和卢旺达的农场调查数据，我们考察了性别与农业抱负形成之间的关系。与先前关于教育和创业的发现相似，我们的结果显示，女性在农业生产方面的抱负较低。针对她们面临的独特挑战，具有性别敏感性的政策对于包容、可持续的农业至关重要。本研究有助于更广泛地理解影响农业产出的多维因素，强调了在农业政策制定中整合多元视角的重要性。

title: A Machine Learning-based Exploration of Resilience and Food Security
Agricultural marketing channels and market prices: Evidence from high-value crop producers in India
abstract: Smallholders in developing and emerging economies face significant challenges when marketing fruits and vegetables. Over the past decades, governments have increased efforts to provide smallholders with marketing outlets, including contracting firms and government-supported outlets like “mandis” in India. This study examines the marketing outlet choices of fruit and vegetable producers in this region and assesses how marketing channel choices influence the prices they receive for their products. Utilizing farm-level data, the study reveals that local crop producers receive higher prices (13 to 73 percent more) when selling through mandis compared to private traders. In comparison, farmers of high-value export crops receive lower prices (19 percent less) when selling through mandis compared to private traders. This disparity emphasizes the need for tailored marketing policies rather than one-size-fits-all approaches for smallholders in development contexts.
abstract_zh: 发展中及新兴经济体的小农在销售水果和蔬菜时面临重大挑战。在过去几十年里，各国政府加大了为小农提供销售渠道的力度，包括签约企业以及印度“mandis”（农产品批发市场）等政府支持的销售渠道。本研究考察了该地区果蔬生产者的销售渠道选择，并评估销售渠道选择如何影响他们产品的售价。利用农场层面的数据，本研究发现，与私人商贩相比，本地作物生产者通过mandis销售时价格更高（高出13%至73%）。相比之下，高价值出口作物的农民通过mandis销售时，价格比私人商贩低19%。这种差异表明，在发展中地区，应当针对小农制定量身定制的销售政策，而非采取一刀切的做法。

title: Climate Change and its impacts on irrigated corn yields in a region of Colorado (USA)
abstract: The future of humanity depends on successfully adapting key cropping systems for food security, such as corn (Zea mays L.), to global climatic changes, including changing air temperatures. We monitored the effects of climate change on harvested yields using long-term research plots that were established in 2001 near Fort Collins, Colorado, and long-term average yields in the region (county). We found that the average temperature for the growing period of the irrigated corn (May to September) has increased at a rate of 0.023 °C yr−1, going from 16.5 °C in 1900 to 19.2 °C in 2019 (p < 0.001), but precipitation did not change (p = 0.897). Average minimum (p < 0.001) temperatures were positive predictors of yields. This response to temperature depended on N fertilizer rates, with the greatest response at intermediate fertilizer rates. Maximum (p < 0.05) temperatures and growing degree days (GDD; p < 0.01) were also positive predictors of yields. We propose that the yield increases with higher temperatures observed here are likely only applicable to irrigated corn and that irrigation is a good climate change mitigation and adaptation practice. However, since pan evaporation significantly increased from 1949 to 2019 (p < 0.001), the region’s dryland corn yields are expected to decrease in the future from heat and water stress associated with increasing temperatures and no increases in precipitation. This study shows that increases in GDD and the minimum temperatures that are contributing to a changing climate in the area are important parameters that are contributing to higher yields in irrigated systems in this region.
abstract_zh: 人类的未来取决于能否成功使主要作物种植系统（如玉米，Zea mays L.）适应全球气候变化（包括气温变化），以保障粮食安全。我们利用2001年在科罗拉多州柯林斯堡（Fort Collins）附近建立的长期研究小区，以及该地区（县）的长期平均产量，监测了气候变化对收获产量的影响。我们发现，灌溉玉米生长期（5月至9月）的平均气温以每年0.023°C的速率上升，从1900年的16.5°C升至2019年的19.2°C（p < 0.001），而降水量未发生变化（p = 0.897）。平均最低气温（p < 0.001）是产量的正向预测因子。这种对气温的响应取决于氮肥施用量，在中等施肥量下响应最大。最高气温（p < 0.05）和生长度日（GDD；p < 0.01）也是产量的正向预测因子。我们认为，此处观察到的气温升高所带来的产量增加可能仅适用于灌溉玉米，而灌溉是一种良好的气候变化减缓与适应措施。然而，由于1949至2019年间蒸发皿蒸发量显著增加（p < 0.001），预计该地区的雨养玉米产量将因气温升高带来的热胁迫和水分胁迫而在未来下降，且降水量并无增加。本研究表明，GDD的增加以及最低气温的上升（二者都在促成该地区的气候变化）是该地区灌溉系统产量提高的重要参数。

title: Leveraging Unsupervised Machine Learning to Examine Women's Vulnerability to Climate Change
abstract: We provide an application of machine learning to identify the distributional consequences of climate change in Malawi. We compare climate impact estimates based on drought indicators established objectively from the k‐means algorithm to more traditional measures. Young women affected by drought were 5 percentage points more likely to be married by 18 than those living in nondrought areas. Our approach generates robust results when varying the number of clusters and definition of treatment status. In some cases, we find the design using k‐means to define treatment is more likely to satisfy the assumptions underlying the difference‐in‐differences strategy than when using arbitrary thresholds. Projections from the estimates indicate future drought risk may lead to larger declines in labor productivity due to women's engagement in early age marriage than other factors affecting their participation rates. Under the extreme representative concentration pathway scenario, drought exposure encourages the exit of 3.3 million women workers by 2100.
abstract_zh: 我们提供了一个机器学习的应用，用以识别气候变化在马拉维造成的分配性后果。我们将基于k均值算法客观确定的干旱指标所得出的气候影响估计，与更传统的衡量方法进行比较。受干旱影响的年轻女性在18岁前结婚的可能性，比生活在非干旱地区的女性高出5个百分点。改变聚类数量和处理状态的定义时，我们的方法都能得到稳健的结果。在某些情况下，我们发现使用k均值来定义处理组，比使用任意阈值更有可能满足双重差分策略所依据的假设。根据估计结果所作的预测表明，未来的干旱风险可能导致劳动生产率的下降幅度大于其他影响女性参与率因素所造成的下降，其原因在于女性因早婚而减少了参与。在极端代表性浓度路径情景下，到2100年，干旱暴露将促使330万名女性劳动者退出劳动力市场。

title: Risk Perceptions of Climate Change, Risk Preferences, and Cacao Farming
venue: Managing Risk in Agriculture: A Development Perspective
abstract: In this study, we investigate cacao farmers’ risk perceptions of climate change and how they relate to the use of agronomic practices that will help them combat the effects of weather variability. We measure risk preferences and risk perceptions using a nationally representative survey and framed field experiments conducted in Ecuador – the world’s largest producer of fine and flavor cacao. We find that cacao farmers, overall, have reasonable perceptions of high risk of climate change. More importantly, we find that relationships between climate change risk perceptions and potential agronomic mitigation activities occur for the case of fertilization practices only. That is, individuals who perceive a greater risk of climate change have higher expenditures on fertilization activities. Finally, we show that these findings are robust to the influence of experimentally elicited risk preference parameters, i.e. prospect theory or DOSPERT parameters. As the perception of risk is a necessary prerequisite for deciding on actions to adapt to climate risk, these results have important policy implications for the development of programs aimed at mitigating the effects of climate change on the cacao sector and the global chocolate industry.
abstract_zh: 在本研究中，我们考察了可可种植者对气候变化的风险认知，以及这些认知与他们采用有助于应对天气变率影响的农艺措施之间的关系。我们利用一项具有全国代表性的调查，以及在厄瓜多尔（全球最大的优质风味可可生产国）开展的框架化田野实验，测量了风险偏好和风险认知。我们发现，总体而言，可可种植者对气候变化的高风险有着合理的认知。更重要的是，我们发现，气候变化风险认知与潜在的农艺缓解措施之间的关系，仅体现在施肥措施上。也就是说，认为气候变化风险更大的个体，在施肥方面的支出更高。最后，我们表明，这些发现对于通过实验得出的风险偏好参数（即前景理论参数或DOSPERT参数）的影响是稳健的。由于风险认知是决定采取适应气候风险行动的必要前提，这些结果对于制定旨在减轻气候变化对可可产业以及全球巧克力产业影响的计划，具有重要的政策意义。

Breaking the Mold: Craft Chocolate Makers Prioritize Quality, Ethical and Direct Sourcing, and Environmental Welfare
venue: Journal of Agriculture and Food Research
abstract: The commodity chocolate industry has been long recognized for unsustainable and unethical production practices. In contrast, the craft chocolate industry is well-positioned to move the chocolate industry in the direction of more ethical sourcing strategies, improved environmentally-conscious production practices, and higher quality products as a whole. Craft chocolate businesses also often adhere to ethical and economical guidelines, providing farmers with significantly higher farm gate prices and more resources than their commodity counterparts. However, poor standardization and understanding of industry needs raises questions regarding the integrity and longevity of this industry. With a survey of craft chocolate makers from around the world and an assessment of craft chocolate bar origins and makers, our data confirms for the first time that many craft chocolate producers prioritize responsible business practices including ethical sourcing (29%) and use of direct trade to source higher quality ingredients (38%). Of those surveyed, 60% of chocolate makers believe that routinely used quality assessment techniques do not meet the needs of craft chocolate makers or could use improvement. In addition, this research found that over 65% of craft chocolate makers primarily source beans from South and Central America (in direct contrast to commodity cacao systems, predominantly sourcing from West Africa). Furthermore, this research identifies gaps to support craft chocolate industry cohesion. The craft chocolate industry recognizes the importance of sustainable development and promotion of farmer welfare and environmental conservation and is a remarkably distinct entity within the chocolate world.
abstract_zh: 商品巧克力行业长期以来因其不可持续和不道德的生产方式而受到认可。相比之下，精品巧克力行业处于有利地位，能够推动巧克力行业朝着更道德的采购策略、更环保的生产实践以及整体更高品质产品的方向发展。精品巧克力企业通常也遵循道德和经济准则，向农民提供远高于商品同行的农场门价以及更多资源。然而，标准化程度低以及对行业需求的理解不足，引发了人们对该行业完整性和长期发展的疑问。通过对全球各地精品巧克力制造商的调查，以及对精品巧克力棒原产地和制造商的评估，我们的数据首次证实，许多精品巧克力生产商优先考虑负责任的商业实践，包括道德采购（29%）以及采用直接贸易以采购更高品质的原料（38%）。在受访者中，60%的巧克力制造商认为，常规使用的质量评估技术无法满足精品巧克力制造商的需求，或者有待改进。此外，本研究发现，超过65%的精品巧克力制造商主要从南美洲和中美洲采购可可豆（与主要从西非采购的商品可可体系形成鲜明对比）。此外，本研究还找出了支撑精品巧克力行业凝聚力方面的不足。精品巧克力行业认识到可持续发展、促进农民福利和环境保护的重要性，是巧克力世界中一个非常独特的主体。
